title: Unified Locaily Application Shell
purpose: Merge the strongest parts of /console and /operator into one coherent application shell so operators do not choose between competing control planes
problem: Workflow console, operator console, dashboards, CLIs, and lifecycle systems make Locaily feel like six internal products.

included: One shell with progressive sections: Home, Runs, Workflows, Capabilities, Models, Nodes, Evidence, Reviews, Memory, Settings
Home screen primary CTA: Run an example workflow (wires to Golden Path)
Integrate existing console validation and operator job/relay panels as routes or panels
Progressive disclosure for raw JSON, audit logs, qualification records
Preserve deep links or redirects from legacy /console and /operator paths
Decision implementation from px1 shell strategy
excluded: Rewriting Benchmark Lab UI from scratch
Development control plane dashboard merge into product shell (keep separate)

acceptanceCriteria.description: One primary browser entry presents Home with Run example CTA
Shell exposes Runs, Workflows, Nodes, Evidence, Reviews at minimum using existing backends
Legacy /console and /operator URLs still work via redirect or embedded mode
Existing Lighthouse golden path and operator job actions remain functional
